chatBot.dailyLimitWithAdminHint: I have answered as many messages as I can today. Please come back tomorrow. If you need help now, ask to talk to a real person.
chatBot.adminGuestFallback: Only logged-in customers with a confirmed email can talk to an admin. Please log in, or create an account and confirm your email, then ask again.
chatBot.adminUnconfirmedFallback: Only customers with a confirmed email can talk to an admin. Please confirm your email with the link we sent you, then ask again.
chatBot.adminAllowedFallback: Please describe your issue for the admin. An admin will be able to reply here later. The bot will stop replying in this thread now.
